sections.name: Chorus
lines: [G]Lag ja gale, [Em]ke fir yeh haseen [G]raat ho [D]na ho
[C]Shayad fir is janam main, [D]mulakat [G]ho na ho [G]

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [C]Shayad fir is janam main, [D]mulakat [G]ho na ho [G]

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [G]Baahein gale mein [C]daal ke [Am]hum ro lein zaar [G]zaar
[G]Aankhon se phir [Em]yeh pyaar ki [G]barsaat ho na [D]ho
[C]Shaayad phir is janam mein [D]mulaqaat [G]ho na ho [G]
